name: Precise Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Established in 1983 and headquartered in Bang Sue, Thailand, Precise Corporation Public Company Limited is a diverse entity with operations spanning several key areas. The company is actively involved in the generation and distribution of electricity derived from renewable sources, serving markets both domestically in Thailand and internationally. Beyond its energy production, it manufactures and supplies critical equipment for electricity transmission. Its service portfolio is extensive, covering project management, the ongoing maintenance of electrical systems, and the repair of electrical apparatus, alongside comprehensive power utility management. Precise Corporation also engages in significant construction projects, building power stations, transmission lines, and high-voltage substations. Further diversifying its capabilities, the company designs and implements software management systems, enterprise platforms, and information systems. Its commercial activities include the import and export of a wide range of electrical and mechanical equipment. Additionally, it specializes in the production, distribution, testing, inspection, and maintenance of switchboard products. The organization formally adopted its current name, Precise Corporation Public Company Limited, in January 2018, having previously operated as Precise Corporation Co., Ltd.
